---
title: "Analyzing NBA Recruits"
author: Genesis
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
#| label: recruits-structure

recruits <- read_excel("data/nba_recruits.xlsx")
glimpse(recruits)
```

```{r}
#| label: recruit-summary

recruits |>
  select(rank, nba_mean_ws48, top_mean_wa, total_seasons, drafted) |>
  summary()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| label: basketball-tibble

basketball_tibble <- recruits |>
  mutate(
    tier = factor(
      tier,
      levels = c(
        "Never played",
        "Brief career",
        "Solid career",
        "All-Star level",
        "Superstar"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    recruit_group = factor(
      recruit_group,
      levels = c(
        "#1–10",
        "#11–25",
        "#26–50",
        "#51–100",
        "Outside top 100"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: recruit-group-tier-chart

basketball_tibble |>
  filter(!is.na(rank), !is.na(top_mean_wa)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, color = tier)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  geom_text(
    data = basketball_tibble |>
      filter(
        name %in% c(
          "LeBron James",
          "Chris Paul",
          "Kevin Durant",
          "Dwight Howard"
        )
      ),
    aes(x = rank, y = top_mean_wa, label = name),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recruit rank",
    y = "Peak Wins Added",
    color = "Career tier"
  )
```
